related_questions.question: How much can a retired person earn without paying taxes in 2021?
related_questions.snippet: For single filers, taxes apply if the combined income is over $25,000. For married couples filing jointly, the threshold is $32,000. Up to 50% of benefits are taxable if combined income is between $25,000 and $34,000 (single) or $32,000 and $44,000 (married filing jointly).

related_questions.question: How do I calculate how much my Social Security will be taxed?
related_questions.snippet: Social Security benefit taxes are based on what the Social Security Administration (SSA) refers to as your “combined” income. That consists of your adjusted gross income, plus any nontaxable interest you earned (and certain other items) and half of your Social Security income.
